## Problem
What is wrong or missing today?

## Proposal
What should change? Be concrete about schema/interface impact.

## Alternatives considered

## Impact
- [ ] Changes L0 (ontology) — requires version bump + migration note
- [ ] Changes L5 (provenance/uncertainty)
- [ ] Changes a public interface (Query/Step/Agent API)
- [ ] Additive only

## Migration
How do existing facts/tiles/code move to the new shape?
